uploads.title: What If a Solar Superstorm Hit Earth Today?
uploads.caption: What If a Solar Superstorm Hit Earth Today?
uploads.description:
In 1859, a solar storm set telegraph wires on fire and painted auroras over Cuba. What would happen if a Carrington-class storm hit our modern, electrified world? From the 1989 Quebec blackout to the 2012 near miss, here's what a solar superstorm could do, and how we're preparing.
